C-CODIFY-DECISIONS.Summary: Give the decisions genre a working retirement trigger. CodifiedIn is the only move: a resolving tag whose named check fails when the invariant is violated, runs unconditionally, and covers every load-bearing clause of that Decision element. TaughtIn stays a resolvable annotation and does not confer eligibility — D31's parallel trigger is narrowed here, not silently. The rulings persistSnapshot call takes the pre-move live size as ceilingBase, the findings timing C-RETIREMENT-WINDOW withheld; at equilibrium the shipped post-move call erases Delta_retired. This bundle writes the record: it tags the live decisions the audit verifies, then --retire moves them in the same wave. D30 is scoped, not skirted. Binding live rulings D28, D28.1, D30, D11. Charter row already live; no position is written.
C-CODIFY-DECISIONS.Problem:
The decisions genre has no working retirement trigger. D28.1 retires a decision when its prose invariant is permanently replaced by an automated machine check that enforces the boundary unconditionally. The shipped move treats a resolving CodifiedIn or TaughtIn as that event (scripts/validate-record-retirement.ts:1008-1012, :1243-1248). D24 is the only Decision ever moved this way, and its tag was gated on two named tests passing at execution, not asserted. Zero live Decision elements carry either child (measured, Assumptions). Pointer resolution alone is not the standard: a kind="test-suite" path that merely exists retires the element, which is F147's manufactured-pass shape on governance.
Codification alone may open no window. C-RETIREMENT-WINDOW applied the pre-move ceilingBase to findings only; the rulings persistSnapshot call omits the fifth argument, so ceilingBase defaults to the post-move base (:883, :1093-1096). At equilibrium that erases Delta_retired (fixture A). Today's production snapshot is clamped under the 1883 provenance ceiling, so a small move currently grows the window by Delta_retired as an accident of that clamp (fixtures B and C), not as the formula. C-RETIREMENT-WINDOW's NonGoal that rulings keep post-move timing is overturned here (CLAUDE.md rule 9): its argument was that measured pressure was absent. The pressure is the unreachable trigger, and at equilibrium the current call site cannot pay for a move.
TaughtIn versus CodifiedIn is unresolved in the live text. D28.1's rationale is that the live reading set no longer needs the prose because a machine enforces the boundary. Teaching a rule in skill prose is not that enforcement. D31 added TaughtIn as a parallel trigger so practice rules would not leave the ceiling as sole enforcement. Manufacturing eligibility on a pinned paragraph would convert D28.1's enforcement into a formality. This spec settles the tag rather than using it by accident.
F187 is already retired, PaidBy C-PAYMENT-RECORD. This bundle does not re-pay it. The charter's remaining work is the trigger, the window, and the verified tags.

Goals.Goal: Rulings window formula, the findings timing. After a --retire that moved at least one element, persist on the rulings live root: base = the post-move line count of rulings.xml; ceiling = min(previously persisted ceiling, Base_live + H), where Base_live is the pre-retirement line count of rulings.xml as read on entry and H = 7 times the median line count of the live H2 Decision elements after the move, via the shipped median and liveH2DecisionLineCounts; headroom = ceiling - base. Pass Base_live as persistSnapshot's fifth argument, the findings call site's pattern (:1085-1091). The min stays. RULINGS_PROVENANCE_CEILING stays; this formula never raises. Registry and index keep their shipped timing.

TaughtIn does not move a decision. retireRecord moves a live Decision if and only if at least one CodifiedIn child resolves. A resolving TaughtIn is not eligibility. Every CodifiedIn and TaughtIn child still has to resolve: a dangling pointer remains an error. decision-eligible-still-live fires on a resolving CodifiedIn only. This narrows D31's parallel trigger for retirement; the original argument is answered in Constraints. Pointer-resolution shapes stay as shipped (kind lint-rule via isEmittableIssueCode; kind test-suite as an existing path; TaughtIn path + section substring).

Every CodifiedIn child is resolved, not only the first. childNodes(..., "CodifiedIn")[0] is replaced by a walk of all CodifiedIn children. One resolving child is still sufficient to retire; a dangling sibling is still an error. D18 carries two lint-rule tags under this rule.

Evidence standard, mechanical. A live Decision may receive a CodifiedIn tag, and therefore become eligible, only when every clause below holds of that element. (1) Fail when violated: a named lint emission or named test is red when the invariant is broken and green when it holds; both directions are re-run at execution. A test that exercises the same area, or a kind="test-suite" path that merely exists, is not this. (2) Unconditional: the check runs on the default lint, review, or test path, not only behind an optional flag. (3) Completeness: every load-bearing clause of that Decision element is covered. A parent is not tagged because a child is. A multi-clause Decision with one clause enforced stays live. (4) Pointer resolution is necessary and not sufficient: the shipped kind/path/section checks still run, and they do not by themselves authorise a tag. (5) Do not manufacture eligibility. Retirement is one-way in practice.

TaughtIn ruling, stated against D31. TaughtIn may exist as a resolvable annotation. It does not confer eligibility. D31 added the parallel trigger because, classified then, most live H2 decisions were practice rules no lint rule could hold, leaving the ceiling as sole enforcement for three quarters of the genre — the shape D28.1 rejected. That argument is answered, not ignored: the honest count is that few live decisions are unconditionally machine- enforced, and that is a fact about D28.1's trigger, not a licence to retire live governance text on a pinned paragraph. Skill prose that states a practice rule still binds the agent who reads it; it does not replace the live ruling. scripts/skill-contracts.test.ts pinning a section is enforcement that the teaching exists, not enforcement of the invariant. This Constraint is the refusal to stretch TaughtIn into a move.

After the move: base = post-move line count; H = 7 times the median post-move live H2 Decision element line count via the shipped median (:123) and liveH2DecisionLineCounts (:769); ceiling = min(previous persisted ceiling, Base_live + H); headroom = ceiling - base. Import median; do not re-implement it. A Decision has no heading-level attribute — H2 is the # prefix of the Title text. The original C-RETIREMENT-WINDOW argument for leaving rulings on post-move timing was that measured pressure was absent and that the CodifiedIn pass was a separate bundle. This is that bundle, and fixture A shows the post-move call at equilibrium yields a window of H_new, which can shrink when the remaining median drops. The min, which forbids a raise, is kept. The provenance check on RULINGS_PROVENANCE_CEILING stays; the failure message continues to name --retire / move to the retired sibling and says raising the persisted ceiling is not the remedy; it never names a config key. Do not pin a scalar count of a record file into this Constraint (D30); occupancy is in Assumptions. Findings already pass pre-move Base_live and are not re-litigated. Registry and index keep their shipped formulas, with C-RETIREMENT-WINDOW's asymmetry argument standing for those two genres.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-RULINGS-WINDOW:
A fixture --retire that moves at least one Decision from an equilibrium rulings snapshot (ceiling = base + H) persists ceiling equal to min(previous ceiling, pre-move base + H_new) and a window of Delta_retired + H_new when that term sets the ceiling. The shipped post-move call fails this probe: fixture A at this spec's writing yielded window = H_new and a negative window_gain. A fixture whose Base_live + H_new exceeds the persisted ceiling keeps the previous ceiling (anti-ratchet). A production-shaped clamped fixture still opens Delta_retired while the provenance ceiling binds.
